title: Timeouts on chat for industrial customer
description: Stark Industries (v1) chat users get 'something went wrong' on longer questions, sometimes after about 8 seconds. Support suspects the LLM gateway is slow and wants the gateway team to add a fallback provider.
provided_evidence: 2025-03-12T10:00:08.000Z INFO ui-r req=req-3a91 tenant=t-stark latency_ms=8000 status=error

ground_truth.root_cause: Provider latency (11s) below llm.timeout_ms but above platform.http.timeout_ms (8s) on v1; the gateway reports success.

key_questions_needed.topic: how long before the error / latency

ground_truth.version_caveat: llm.failover.enabled does not exist on v1; mitigation is raising platform.http.timeout_ms, or upgrade.

scenario.query: How do I reset the device?

ground_truth.observed_symptom: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
